title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Internal inconsistency between pseudocode and Python example
description:
Line 85 pseudocode specifies 'N = MAX(NChannels - 1, 2)' but line 305 Python example uses 'n = max(n_channels - 1, 1)'. This inconsistency exists in actual code too: ccp.py:97 uses max(...,2) while link/channel.py:77,129 uses max(...,1). These produce different channel assignments when n_channels is 2 or 3.

Fix suggestion: Align on one formula. If max(...,2) is correct, update line 305 Python example. If max(...,1) is correct, update line 85 and line 159 pseudocode. Also fix the corresponding Python implementations.
close_reason: Fixed: aligned channel formula to max(n_channels - 1, 2) per spec pseudocode in link/channel.py lines 77,129 and spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md line 304 Python example
